section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study that investigates the moderating effect of a perceived relationship with God on the inverse relationship between social comparison and body appreciation. The study involved a sample of 186 female undergraduates from two private, Christian colleges in the USA. It reviews the theoretical background of social comparison theory and attachment theory, and discusses previous research linking religiosity and attachment to God with body image.
